channel.title: Block Club Chicago - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Block Club Chicago (blockclubchicago.org)

item.title: Lakeview Neighbors Consider Landmark District After Greystone Demolition
item.description: The conversation was sparked after a greystone on Newport Avenue was torn down, alarming neighbors who said the loss threatened one of the area’s most intact stretches of early 20th century two- and three-flats.

item.title: Kristen Pierce-Sherrod, Harold’s Chicken Shack CEO, Dies At 55: ‘Harold’s Was A Family’
item.description: Harold's Chicken Shack was a cornerstone of Kristen Pierce-Sherrod's life long before she took the role of CEO in 2000, she shared in a 2022 interview.

item.title: Irene’s Finer Diner Nears Opening, The Piggery Is Closing — Plus More North Side Food News
item.description: The owners of The Piggery in North Center are retiring after 15 years. And a new Thai spot in Albany Park is serving street food typically found while walking through Isan, the country's largest region.

item.title: Chicago Wikipedia Contributors Celebrate 25 Years Of Aggregating Knowledge
item.description: Local Wikipedia contributors are coming together for the site's 25th anniversary this weekend. They aim to keep growing the Chicago community of volunteer editors.

item.title: On-And-Off Snow Showers Expected In Chicago Through The Weekend
item.description: Hundreds of flights have been delayed at O'Hare Airport due to Friday's snow — and the Bears will face frigid temperatures when they host the Los Angeles Rams on Sunday.

item.title: Mouse Arts And Letters, A New Bridgeport Social Club, Brings Artists And Writers Together
item.description: Located in an old bank building, the arts social club will serve as a co-working space and host a variety of free events revolving around arts, literature, history and politics.

item.title: St. Stanislaus Kostka Academy To Close In Wicker Park After More Than 150 Years
item.description: The Catholic elementary school has been open since 1874. The parish's pastor cited plummeting enrollment and a loss of government scholarship funds as factors in its closure.

item.title: Bally’s Wants To Extend River North Stay As Permanent Casino Might Not Open Until 2027
item.description: A new state bill would give Bally’s up to a year more at its temporary downtown casino while its $1.7 billion permanent site remains under construction.

item.title: Friends, Loved Ones Put Together Gallery To Honor 22-Year-Old Killed In Pilsen Hit-And-Run
item.description: Six months after a fatal hit-and-run, Marcela Herrera's friends and family will pay tribute to her loving soul and character Monday. "Even if her cup wasn't always full, she found a way to pour into other people's cups," a friend said.

item.title: Friends Start GoFundMe To Help Family Of Late Bronzeville Teacher
item.description: The family is also accepting submissions for a memory book in honor of the Healy Elementary teacher ahead of funeral services next week.
